goal: Rank repos by authored commits over the last 90 days; choose one or Skip to create a local repo and report its actual path.

notes: Use /repo.choose and /repo.create; source counts through existing same-origin GitHub proxy, extend upstream only if required. Default ~/Smithers/repositories/smithers-playground, collision suffix; no overwrites. Export local route registration for login owner to mount. /repo.open opens an existing repo; initialization itself is a gap. Cloud browser must hand off to local host, never pretend its filesystem exists. All listed files are exclusively owned by this lane; new test/helper files must use the lane prefix.
